Reasoning: The question states that there is a natural harbor at Jia, so judge the climate of the place where this harbor is located. Jia is located near about 30° on the west coast of a continent, belonging to a subtropical west-coast-of-continent region, whose typical climate is a Mediterranean climate. The precipitation characteristic of a Mediterranean climate is that it is rainy in winter under the influence of westerlies and hot and dry in summer. Therefore the climatic characteristic of this harbor is rainy in winter.

If there is a natural harbor at place Jia, what are the climatic characteristics of this harbor?

method.method_draft: First describe the map: sea is on the west/left, land is on the east/right, and 甲 lies on the coastal boundary near the marked 30° latitude. From the text, note that the place is a天然港湾 at 甲, so the requested object is the coastal site’s climate. Classify 甲 as a subtropical west-coast location around 30°–40°. Apply the Mediterranean-climate distribution rule and state its precipitation characteristic: winter is the rainy season, i.e. 冬季多雨.
